answer: Saw plates and beech handles wait on the saw-maker's bench, the teeth still uncut. oasis files the teeth one by one and sets them even along the plate. Proof of saw-maker via toothed saw tally — a saw the saw-maker sets only after 1439 saws cut true without one saw binding at the kerf, each set by the saw-maker himself. gale fits the handle to the plate and rivets it fast. inlet tests the finished saw on a board and listens for the ring. One thousand four hundred and thirty-nine saws must cut true without one saw binding at the kerf, and the next still binds where the set ran uneven.
